diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The agent failed Q1 because it returned only 8 eids (author + 7 meeting participants) instead of 11. The expected answer includes additional contributors identified from evidence across other artifacts (e.g., PR authors, doc editors, chat contributors) beyond just the meeting participants. The skill's 'Key reviewer extraction rules' needs stronger guidance to aggregate contributors from ALL artifact types (PRs, chats, doc revisions, URLs) linked to the report, not just the review meeting participants. Q2 and Q3 passed value checks (only length check failed on q1).

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill's reviewer/contributor extraction rules caused the agent to equate 'key reviewers' with meeting participants only, missing 3 additional contributors who appear in other artifacts (PRs, chat threads, doc edit history, or referenced sub-documents) tied to the CoachForce/CoFoAIX Market Research Report. The anti-distractor rules are overly conservative and exclude legitimate cross-artifact contributors.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Strengthen the 'Key reviewer extraction rules' section to explicitly require multi-hop aggregation of ALL contributors tied to the target report, not just meeting participants. Add a mandatory checklist: (1) document author(s) and co-author(s) from doc metadata; (2) explicit 'reviewers' field if present; (3) all participants in review meetings referencing the doc; (4) authors/reviewers of PRs that reference or modify the doc; (5) chat/slack users who provided substantive feedback in threads mentioning the doc (by title, codename, or doc_id); (6) commenters/editors in doc revision history. Instruct the subagent to search by BOTH the public product name AND internal codename (e.g., CoachForce AND CoFoAIX) across every artifact type before finalizing the contributor list. Add an explicit warning: 'Do NOT stop at meeting participants — always sweep PRs, chats, and doc history for additional named contributors, as expected answers typically include 10+ people for major reports.' Also add a self-check step requiring the agent to re-scan all artifact types once a candidate list is formed to confirm completeness.
